newsitem.title: USA: CDSI starts $20.25/shr tender for Control.
newsitem.headline: CDSI starts $20.25/shr tender for Control.

text.p: CDSI Holding Corp said Tuesday its subsidiary CDSI Acquisition Corp started its tender offer for Control Data Systems Inc for $20.25 cash a share.
The companies announced the offer, which is subject to receipt of 51 percent of Control's fully-diluted stock, July 9. The offer expires August 11 unless extended.
CDSI, formed at the direction of investment firm Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, said two affiliated investment funds have pledged $300 million in financing for the deal.

Control Data had about 13.95 million shares outstanding in the first quarter, when the company booked $16.6 million in net earnings, or $1.19 a share (including a $15 million gain, or $1.08 a share). This compared with a $2.9 million net, or $0.20 a share, the year before.
Control's stock traded at 20-1/4 Tuesday afternoon, up 1/16.
